data.positioning_statement: For emerging to mid-market Shopify fashion brands, Fitcheck is an AI fit-confidence experience that adds a visual try-on moment to the product page, helping shoppers make a more informed decision without presenting a result as sizing certainty or a promised commercial outcome.
points_of_difference: A product-page confidence layer rather than a claim of perfect fit, conversion lift, or return reduction.
A guided, bounded rollout path rather than an open-ended custom implementation project.
An editorial, fashion-aware expression rather than generic AI novelty or competitor imitation.
Merchant-specific learning as the basis for future measurement rather than pre-claimed outcomes.
